instruction: Crystal Oscillator Placement Rules The file design.kicad_pcb contains an MCU (U1), an 8 MHz crystal (Y1), and two load capacitors (C1, C2). The crystal and capacitors are not yet arranged as a usable oscillator network. Reposition them into a sensible oscillator layout around the MCU and write the result as design.kicad_pcb. Requirements: 1. The crystal (Y1) centre must be within 5 mm of the MCU's OSC_IN pad. 2. Both load capacitors (C1, C2) must be on the same copper layer as the crystal. 3. Both load caps must be placed within 10 mm of the crystal centre. 4. A keepout zone must be added on layer In1.Cu under the crystal body (the zone must contain the crystal centre point). 5. The MCU (U1) position must not change. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
